description_zh: Zoox 车辆在绿灯下右转时，左侧相邻车道的大卡车突然右转切入，与 Zoox 左前传感器发生碰撞。选择 Zoox 为 ego，测试其应对相邻车辆突然切入的能力。

source_snippets: A Zoox vehicle in manual mode was proceeding southbound in the turn lane on Sixth Street with a green light, yielding to a pedestrian before completing a right turn onto eastbound Harrison Street...
A large truck in the left adjacent lane abruptly turned right and cut in front of the Zoox vehicle making contact with the left front sensor.
evidence.reason: 报告描述了一辆卡车从左侧相邻车道突然右转切入正在右转的 Zoox 车辆前方，导致碰撞。这符合 cut_in 行为原语，且 ego 正在移动并执行右转，具有测试价值。
